scope: Implement local live research dashboard, causal online evaluation/diagnostics, explicit recurrent ablations and a bounded L4 experiment handoff. No scientific fits or remote resource allocation in this implementation task.
verification: Bounded single-thread CPU synthetic correctness and browser/API checks; real data, GPU performance, training quality and original GALAM identity remain unverified.
primary_validation: Official earlier train for fitting; full later official valid for primary reporting. Whole sequences and connected-component exclusions. No chronology inferred from seq_ix; previously inspected valid remains exposed.

monitoring.metrics: Flat finite numeric map with slash-separated names; absent measurements stay absent.
monitoring.metadata: Reuse immutable run_metadata.json where available; dashboard may report incomplete metadata explicitly.
monitoring.comparability: Online train/loss is separate from comparable train_eval/loss and valid/loss. Official full valid scores are separate from diagnostics. Never manufacture unmeasured values.
monitoring.service: Loopback-only local read-only HTTP dashboard, offline assets, bounded incremental reads, explicit stale/error status. No training start/stop or shell endpoint.

owners.root: Integration, experiment packet, resource reasoning, acceptance and independent-review coordination
owners.dashboard_builder: Dashboard reader/server/offline UI and API/security/partial-log tests
owners.metrics_builder: Canonical sequence-loop integration, full valid and comparable train-eval metrics, diagnostics and resource event production
owners.variants_builder: Explicit GRU and local-only adaptations with causal/reset/chunk tests; original LSTM template preserved

budgets.remote_actions: One persistent SSH connection for read-only L4 inventory after the user supplied the host; no remote file mutation or compute allocation.
budgets.aggregate_heavy_tests: Serialize across roles; no GPU work.

prospective_panel: Initially 3 arms x 2 matched seeds = 6 total scientific fits, subject to exact runnable-recipe and receiving-host profile. Not dispatched.
limitations: No original GALAM dimensions, weights or complete training recipe
Live L4 inventory is in L4_PREFLIGHT.json; incomplete data, full disks and unaudited runtime block fitting
No measured LSTM/GRU slowdown or L4 ETA
